name: Millennium BCP (Portugal)
description: Cleanup rules for Millennium BCP remittance shapes observed in real EB production data. Rules are ordered most-specific first; first terminal match wins.

rules.name: lev-atm-with-location
rules.description: BCP ATM withdrawal — extract location, drop cardholder echo. Cardholder gap is >=4 spaces; internal location double-spaces (VILA  NOVA) collapsed.

tests.in: LEV ATM 5962 703   LISBOA        Mario Nunes E
LEV ATM 5962 703   VILA  NOVA        Mario Nunes E

rules.name: lev-atm-fallback
rules.description: Line starts with LEV ATM but doesn't fit the location-extraction shape — collapse to bare ATM rather than leaving the noisy line.

rules.name: dd-with-reference
rules.description: BCP direct debit: 'DD <merchant> <8+ digit ref> [<alpha sub-product>] (PT|DI)<id>'. Merchant is non-digit so descriptors that embed numbers (DD ACME 2024 PT...) fall through to dd-fallthrough rather than mis-cutting.

rules.name: dd-short-reference
rules.description: BCP DD line that has a PT/DI authorization id but no 8+ digit booking reference (so dd-with-reference rejected it). Strip the PT/DI tail and collapse internal whitespace so short merchant codes (SUNSETFITGYM 2010) aggregate cleanly.

rules.name: dd-fallthrough
rules.description: DD line that didn't match either reference rule (no PT/DI tail at all). Strip 'DD ' prefix, preserve the rest verbatim.

rules.name: compra-le-fournil-d
rules.description: BCP-truncated French bakery name (LE FOURNIL D'Antoine) where COMPRA descriptor leaves an ANT-prefixed booking reference. Strip it so the merchant aggregates.

tests.in: COMPRA 5962 LE FOURNIL D ANT2136790 CONTACTLESS

rules.name: compra-air-serbia
rules.description: AIR SERBIA flight booking via COMPRA — drop the embedded booking reference (single uppercase letter + 8+ digits) so all flights aggregate to one payee.

tests.in: COMPRA 5962 AIR SERBIA A21296337235 Belgrade RS

rules.name: compra-bolt
rules.description: BOLT ride share — the booking reference (single uppercase letter + 6+ digits) is concatenated directly to the 'BOLT.EU' merchant tag with no separator. Drop the ref so all rides aggregate to one payee.

rules.name: compra-glovo
rules.description: GLOVO delivery via COMPRA — bank glues a per-order date tag (DDMON, e.g. '02APR') and an alphanumeric order ref ('LIFLGYHWL') between the 'GLOVO' merchant and the location. Drop both so all Glovo orders aggregate to one payee per locale.

rules.name: compra-card-purchase
rules.description: BCP card purchase: 'COMPRA NNNN <merchant> [CONTACTLESS]'. NNNN is the last-4 of the card or a category code (5962, 9800).

tests.in: COMPRA 9800 MACAS DE ADAO LISBOA PT CONTACTLESS

rules.name: trf-seguro-viagem
rules.description: BCP-routed travel insurance via TRF P — bank appends an AV booking reference per policy. Strip it so all policies aggregate to one payee.

tests.in: TRF P  Seguro Viagem ON OFF AV787342440282

rules.name: trf-person
rules.description: BCP transfer to/from person: 'TRF <variant> <name>'. Variants: DE (incoming), MB WAY P (mobile pay), P (outgoing), P O (outgoing alternate).

tests.in: TRF MB WAY P  SONAM MALLA

rules.name: pagserv-empresa-portuguesa-das
rules.description: BCP service payment to Empresa Portuguesa Das (postal/telecom) — strip service code + phone-number tail.

rules.name: pagserv-generic
rules.description: Generic BCP service payment — strip 'PAGSERV ' prefix, leave the rest.

rules.name: pag-bxval-via-verde
rules.description: BCP toll/parking payment via the Via Verde tag system — strip 'PAG BXVAL- NNNN ' prefix.

rules.name: com-man-conta-monthly-fee
rules.description: BCP monthly account-maintenance fee with trailing 6-digit period code (MMyyyy). Drop the period so all months aggregate.
